apparent_contradiction_resolved.observation: the direct module probe selected the WEEKEND threshold (2.952$ on H1) while the site reported the WEEKDAY one (0.980$)
apparent_contradiction_resolved.cause: the site strips the in-progress candle and decides on the last CLOSED bar (09:00Z), so its last day-break is the previous weekday open; my probe used the raw feed including the 09:45Z forming bar, whose break is the 132303s Fri-20:59 -> Sat-09:45 weekend gap
apparent_contradiction_resolved.verdict: same logic, different (and correct) input slice - the site's closed-bar-only behaviour is the causal one. NOT a wiring defect.
